newsitem.title: LATVIA: AIR BALTIC IN $24 MLN 1996 REVENUES.
newsitem.headline: AIR BALTIC IN $24 MLN 1996 REVENUES.

text.p: Latvian national carrier Air Baltic, in which Scandinavian Airlines owns one third, said its operating and investment expenses were $41 million in 1996 while operating revenue was $24 million.
The company said in a statement released late on Friday that 75 percent of its revenues in 1996 came from ticket sales outside Latvia.
A company spokesman told Reuters that Air Baltic was now at breakeven on the operating side. It said in a statement that its assets were worth $27.3 million.
The government owns 51.07 percent of the airline, SAS 28.51 percent, Baltic International USA INC 8.02 percent while a Danish and Swedish investment fund each own 6.2 percent.
